raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 holds 690 rows, about double the normal ~350. At 2026-01-17 05:00 it was re-delivered with the same txn_ids, and txn_ts arrived as epoch milliseconds instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (for example, 1768543211000 is exactly 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, matching the original row). That format breaks the TIMESTAMP cast, and the 345 duplicate rows (5320 rows vs 4975 distinct txn_ids) would double-count batch 12 in every gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, batch_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{13}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000) WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{10}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
